notes.title: Update 1.4: Costume Frenzy
notes.content:
In Update 1.4, you can actually see visually what item you have equipped by looking at Diesel! This update also includes minor updates to battles to make it more engaging and fun. Minor updates to the game as a whole have been made too.

[b]-Updates:[/b]

[b]-Battle:[/b]
- If you have Critical hit unlocked, it is guaranteed to happen within the percentage. Example if you have 20% Critical hit it will happen within the next 5 turns
- Diesel now walks into the battle scene and out
- Can't equip items in battle or in major cutscenes
- Diesel wears item costumes in battle
- New Mental attack where you have to avoid fireballs
- Hair dryer now only does fireball mental attack
- The Goofy Mental Attack where you dodge Mental Diesels has been removed

[b]-Other Updates:[/b]
- Diesel now can wear item costumes
- Diesel and Fred have an updated title screen movement code 
- New boot splash for when the game is loading up

Other small things included. Thank you for playing the game. We really do appreciate all of you guys playing the game. We don't know if the game will be coming to other platforms like Mac or Steam Deck.

In this update, we update stuff like the tutorial and other small things too. 

[b]Tutorial:[/b]
-Changes to the text in the Tutorial Diesel popups
-Make it more obvious that Diesel can't attack without finishing the tutorial
-When talking to Fred he will point out things like checking your map or making sure if the player has equipped an item so they can get the full DTPW experience

[b]Other Stuff:[/b]
- Easy Attack says about how much EP it will give the player
- The health bar in a battle goes to the Hundredth point when rounded is turned on
- Fix Camera in one of the town house's
- Fix the press E in the bottom corner to be less flickery

Here at 2Bros, we do appreciate your opinion on bugs you find or other stuff in our game. I mean we have played our game too much we still miss stuff and like ideas on how to improve.

A Mac build hasn't happened yet, we are trying but don't know when it will happen.

notes.title: A Speedy Battle Update
notes.content:
Here is update V1.2 speeding out and with it are a lot of improvements and changes to the game!

[b]Battle:[/b]
- Easy attack gives 1EP back always and Dank Hat gives 2-3 EP back.
- Speed and intensity of attack now decide whose attack will go first in a battle.
- Indicators can appear next to the Enemy's health showing what they will do next.
- Instead of missing more when fighting shadows you resist them always when using your physical attacks.
- Food's benefits have been greatly improved making it much more useful at the start.
- Health Bar has a smooth animation to show when Diesel or an enemy is damaged.
- More Normal Type Battle Backgrounds.
- Heal and Food have priority.
- The Battle scenes are loaded at the start of the game so the first battle you enter should not take so long to load.
- Mental Enemies timer for the chase mental traps has been shortened.
- Fred is now a Mental Type Boss.
- The FireBall Mental Attack is more likely to happen if fighting a hair dryer or Fred.

[b]Side Quests:[/b]
- Added side quest to pay up Aurora the Cat outside of the kingdom town 1k so that you can get Critical Hit on your attacks.
- Changed side quest for getting the Heart Steal attack with having to beat the Mini Trials in Diesel's Cardboard house.
- Changed side quest for getting the Heal Stop from giving chicken to Fred to instead fighting him.

[b]Inventory:[/b]
- Changed how you move between pages in Inventory.
- If you close the inventory and reopen it stays on the page you were on.
- Inventory tells you what Item you are holding to be more clear.
- New Objective part of the Main page.

[b]Other Updates:[/b]
- Trees have been changed to a new design.
- Mini Trials has more levels and resembles The Mystifying Trial more.
- Some spelling errors fixed. I bet there is still more that I can't find.
- Resolution has been set to expand to [b]1280 by 720 [/b].
- Fix Diesel sliding into the meet Luna cutscene.
- Changed Page indicator.

There are other small changes too. If you find any bugs please post them. Here at 2Bros, we like to hear feedback and how much you are enjoying our game!

Another minor update coming soon with the Mac Build so you can play on a Mac.
